new_paintings.slot: (a) Advent: Chant Year/Learn boards, 'Learn Rorate Cæli before Advent' card; Year board's Advent season
new_paintings.work: The Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables
new_paintings.creator: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo (1617–1682)
new_paintings.commons_search: Murillo Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables Prado
new_paintings.why: Rorate cæli desuper — the heavens dropping down the Just One; Advent's Marian expectation, in the bundle's Spanish Baroque register (cf. the Velázquez Coronation).
new_paintings.alternate: Philippe de Champaigne, The Annunciation (c. 1644) (The Met, CC0 if open access) — if a scene rather than an icon is wanted

new_paintings.creator: Jusepe de Ribera (1591–1652)
new_paintings.collection: Real Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial (a variant of the Prado's picture)
new_paintings.why: The Throne of Grace (the Father holding the dead Son, the Dove above) — tenebrist palette that sits beside the Caravaggio Entombment and Velázquez Crucifixion.
new_paintings.alternate: Guido Reni, The Holy Trinity (1625–26), Santissima Trinità dei Pellegrini, Rome

new_paintings.creator: William-Adolphe Bouguereau (1825–1905)

flagged.work: Photograph of Carlo Acutis (head and shoulders, red polo, mountains behind)
flagged.creator: Unknown; the widely circulated family photograph (c. 2005–06)
flagged.licence: Not established — almost certainly in copyright (a modern photograph; the Acutis family / Associazione Amici di Carlo Acutis control the official images)
flagged.note: Used in CarloAcutisView (CachedAssetImage("carlo_acutis")). Do not ship without permission. Replacement options, in order: (1) written permission from the Associazione Carlo Acutis (carloacutis.com) for this photograph; (2) a freely licensed photograph on Commons (fetch.py --search 'Carlo Acutis' lists any, with licence; as of the last check most Commons images of him were deleted as non-free, so expect none); (3) no photograph: the page draws the votive candle or a monogram instead. A painted 'old master' image cannot exist for a saint who died in 2006, so the brief's 'same style' replacement is not possible here.
